_meta.methodology: Reviewed publicly accessible official operator pages only: membership pages, pricing pages, booking/product pages, FAQs, location pages, and official rate pages. No personal email, phone number, account creation, lead form submission, employer discount, or sales-contact flow was used. monthlyPrice is the lowest clearly published ongoing monthly recurring in-person membership only when the source made it safe to compare. annualFee, enrollmentFee, initiationFee, and setupFee are recorded separately when shown. dayPassPrice is a single class, single workout, day pass, or drop-in only when explicit. Limited-time, intro, student, family, paid-in-full, resident, and promotional rates are preserved in notes but not used as the primary monthly price.
limitations: Some official pages hide live rates behind JavaScript booking widgets, account creation, location-specific quote forms, or sales inquiry flows.
Several boutique studios publish intro offers and class packs more clearly than ongoing monthly memberships; those were not forced into monthlyPrice.
Published monthly pricing may exclude taxes, processing fees, freeze fees, late fees, equipment rentals, or commitment-length terms unless the official page names them.
Prices and mandatory fees can change without notice; verify with the operator before publishing user-facing recommendations.
